scheme_name: ICAR Junior Research Fellowship For Post-Graduate Studies In Agricultural Sciences
other_conditions: Candidates must have passed their Bachelor’s degree or be appearing in the final examination under the 10+2+5, 10+2+4 or 10+2+3 (basic science) scheme

Applicants must achieve at least 60% marks or the equivalent OGPA thresholds for General, OBC and Under‑Privileged States categories, and at least 55% marks or the equivalent OGPA thresholds for SC, ST and Physically Handicapped categories
For admission to the M.V.Sc. program, candidates must have completed B.V.Sc. & A.H. with internship before registration

The fellowship is only available for admission to the listed Agricultural Universities (State Agricultural Universities, Deemed Universities, and Central Universities with agriculture faculties) and not to any other universities
No relaxation is permitted for the minimum age limit of 19 years
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹12,000 for Veterinary Sciences and ₹8,640 for other disciplines, plus an annual contingency grant of ₹6,000.
